gloss: healthy body; state of good health

definitions.gloss: healthy body; state of good health; clean bill of health
definitions.explanation: A body that is in good physical health with no medical problems. Often used when describing someone who has been medically cleared or is in excellent physical condition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、{健康体|けんこうたい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: After the examination, I was told I have a clean bill of health.

examples.japanese: {健康体|けんこうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Exercise is essential to maintaining a healthy body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧70⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{健康体|けんこうたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even past 70, he is in good health and jogs every day.

notes:
{健康体|けんこうたい} refers to a body in good physical condition with no medical issues. A compound of ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (healthy) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {健康体|けんこうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧: to maintain a healthy body
- {健康体|けんこうたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to a healthy state
- {健康体|けんこうたい}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧: to be in good health

USAGE:
Often used in medical contexts, especially after checkups or physical examinations. A typical pattern is ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、{健康体|けんこうたい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (the examination showed a clean bill of health).

SIMILAR WORDS:
Compare with ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (general health), which is broader and can include mental well-being. {健康体|けんこうたい} focuses specifically on the physical body being free of illness.
